title: PrixCar Services Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Wallenius Wilhelmsen Logistics Australia Pty Limited
targets: Wallenius Wilhelmsen Logistics Australia Pty Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Former proposed decision date of 22 February 2018 delayed to allow the merger parties time to provide previously requested information.
Following notification by the merger parties that the proposed merger has been terminated, the ACCC has discontinued this review.

body_sections.Summary: PrixCar proposed to acquire WWLA. As consideration for the sale, WWL (the owner of WWLA) would acquire a 20 per cent equity interest in PrixCar.
